source_refs.note: Exercise 1.4, Question 1: book p. 28, Q1 (i)-(vi) exponential and logarithmic equations; answer key book p. 299 (PDF 301)

blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: dono taraf ek ek logarithm hai, aur dono ka base 10 hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\log(3x - 2) = \log(x^2 - 5x + 6)\). Find kya karna hai? Woh tamam \(x\) jo is ko poora karein.
Rule kaunsa? Logarithm one-to-one hai: base ek jaisa ho aur logs barabar hon to arguments bhi barabar.
Plan: pehle domain, phir arguments barabar, phir quadratic, aur aakhir mein har root ko domain se milana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log(3x - 2) = \log(x^2 - 5x + 6)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real solutions \(x\).
Tareeqa: logarithm one-to-one hai, is liye arguments barabar rakh denge. Lekin quadratic se do roots aayenge, aur domain faisla karega ke kaun si root sahi hai.

Domain
\[3x - 2 > 0 \Rightarrow x > \tfrac{2}{3}\]
\[x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3) > 0\]
\[\Rightarrow x < 2 \text{ or } x > 3\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]\tfrac{2}{3}, 2[ \cup ]3, \infty[\]
Kyun: har logarithm ko positive argument chahiye, aur dono shartein ek saath poori honi chahiyen. \((x - 2)(x - 3)\) tab positive hai jab dono factors negative (\(x < 2\)) ya dono positive (\(x > 3\)) hon.

Arguments barabar rakhein
\[3x - 2 = x^2 - 5x + 6\]
\[x^2 - 8x + 8 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\log u = \log v \iff u = v\). Sab terms ek taraf le aaye taa ke quadratic standard shakal mein aa jaye.

Quadratic formula
\[x = \dfrac{8 \pm \sqrt{64 - 32}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \pm 4\sqrt{2}}{2} = 4 \pm 2\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: \(a = 1,\ b = -8,\ c = 8\); yeh quadratic factor nahi hota, is liye formula lagaya. \(\sqrt{32} = \sqrt{16 \times 2} = 4\sqrt{2}\).

Domain se milayein
\(4 - 2\sqrt{2} \approx 1.17\), jo \(]\frac{2}{3}, 2[\) mein hai: qabool.
\(4 + 2\sqrt{2} \approx 6.83\), jo \(]3, \infty[\) mein hai: qabool.
Kyun: root tabhi solution hai jab us par dono logarithms maujood hon. Yahan dono roots pass ho gayin.
Dhyan dein: har dafa aisa nahi hota; agle part mein ek root rad hogi.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 4 - 2\sqrt{2}\) par:
\[3x - 2 = 10 - 6\sqrt{2} \approx 1.51 > 0\]
Kyun: har root par dono arguments barabar hain (roots isi tarah to nikli thin), is liye sirf ek argument ka positive hona kaafi hai. Dono taraf \(\log(1.51\ldots)\) aata hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul part (i) jaisa sawal hai, bas yahan natural logarithm (\(\ln\), base \(e\)) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\ln(x^2 - 1) = \ln(3x - 2)\). Find kya karna hai? Real solutions \(x\).
Rule kaunsa? \(\ln\) bhi one-to-one hai, is liye arguments barabar.
Plan: domain, arguments barabar, quadratic, aur jo root domain se bahar ho usay rad karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\ln(x^2 - 1) = \ln(3x - 2)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real solutions \(x\).
Tareeqa: \(\ln\) one-to-one hai, is liye arguments barabar rakhenge; phir domain se roots ko chhantenge.

Domain
\[x^2 - 1 > 0 \Rightarrow x < -1 \text{ or } x > 1\]
\[3x - 2 > 0 \Rightarrow x > \tfrac{2}{3}\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]1, \infty[\]
Kyun: dono arguments positive hone chahiyen. Number line par dekhein to dono shartein sirf \(x > 1\) par ek saath poori hoti hain.

Arguments barabar rakhein
\[x^2 - 1 = 3x - 2\]
\[x^2 - 3x + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ln u = \ln v \iff u = v\).

Quadratic formula
\[x = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{9 - 4}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{5}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(a = 1,\ b = -3,\ c = 1\); discriminant \(5\) perfect square nahi, is liye jawab surd mein rahega.

Domain se milayein
\(\frac{3 + \sqrt{5}}{2} \approx 2.618 > 1\): qabool.
\(\frac{3 - \sqrt{5}}{2} \approx 0.382\), jo 1 se bara nahi: rad.
Kyun: \(x \approx 0.382\) par \(3x - 2 \approx -0.854 < 0\), to \(\ln(3x - 2)\) maujood hi nahi.
Dhyan dein: quadratic ki dono roots ko seedha jawab likh dena sab se aam ghalti hai; aisi faltu root ko extraneous root kehte hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = \frac{3 + \sqrt{5}}{2}\) par \(x^2 = 3x - 1\) (quadratic se), is liye
\[x^2 - 1 = 3x - 2 \approx 5.854 > 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono arguments barabar aur positive hain, to dono taraf ka \(\ln\) barabar hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan left side par do logarithms ka jama hai aur right side par ek logarithm.
Diya kya hai? \(\log(x) + \log(x^2 - 5x + 7) = \log(3)\). Find kya karna hai? Real solutions \(x\).
Rule kaunsa? Product law se left side ko ek log banayenge, phir one-to-one property.
Plan: domain, product law, arguments barabar, cubic ko factor karna, aur roots ko domain se milana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\log(x) + \log(x^2 - 5x + 7) = \log(3)\).
Maloom karna: tamam real solutions \(x\).
Tareeqa: product law se left side ek logarithm banegi; phir arguments barabar rakh kar ek cubic equation milegi jise factor karenge.

Domain
\[x > 0\]
\[x^2 - 5x + 7 = \left(x - \tfrac{5}{2}\right)^2 + \tfrac{3}{4} > 0\]
\[\text{Domain} = ]0, \infty[\]
Kyun: completing the square se pata chala ke doosra argument hamesha positive hai (square kabhi negative nahi, upar se \(\frac{3}{4}\) jama). Is liye sirf \(x > 0\) wali shart bachti hai.

Product law aur arguments barabar
\[\log[x(x^2 - 5x + 7)] = \log 3\]
\[x^3 - 5x^2 + 7x = 3\]
\[x^3 - 5x^2 + 7x - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\log m + \log n = \log(mn)\), phir \(\log u = \log v \iff u = v\).

Cubic ko factor karein
\[x^3 - x^2 - 4x^2 + 4x + 3x - 3\]
\[= (x - 1)(x^2 - 4x + 3)\]
\[= (x - 1)^2(x - 3)\]
Kyun: coefficients ka jama \(1 - 5 + 7 - 3 = 0\) hai, is ka matlab \(x = 1\) root hai aur \((x - 1)\) factor hai. Phir terms ko is tarah tora ke har jore se \((x - 1)\) nikle.

Roots aur domain
\(x = 1\) (do dafa aane wali root) ya \(x = 3\). Dono positive hain, is liye dono domain mein hain.
Kyun: repeated root bhi ek hi value hai, set mein usay ek dafa likhte hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 1\): \(\log 1 + \log(1 - 5 + 7) = 0 + \log 3 = \log 3\) \(\checkmark\)
\(x = 3\): \(\log 3 + \log(9 - 15 + 7) = \log 3 + \log 1 = \log 3\) \(\checkmark\)

blocks.explanation:
Yeh exponential equation hai jis mein \(3^{x+1}\) aur \(9^x\) hain; dono ko 3 ki powers mein likha ja sakta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(3^{(x+1)} - 2 \cdot 9^x + 9 = 0\). Find kya karna hai? Real solutions \(x\).
Rule kaunsa? Substitution: \(y = 3^x\) rakhne se yeh quadratic ban jati hai.
Plan: sab kuch \(3^x\) mein likhna, quadratic hal karna, negative value rad karna, phir \(x\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3^{(x+1)} - 2 \cdot 9^x + 9 = 0\).
Maloom karna: tamam real solutions \(x\).
Tareeqa: \(3^{x+1}\) aur \(9^x\) dono ko \(3^x\) ki shakal mein likhenge, phir \(y = 3^x\) rakh kar quadratic hal karenge.

Domain
\[\text{Domain} = ]-\infty, \infty[\]
Kyun: exponentials har real number ke liye maujood hain, koi value nikalni nahi parti.

\(3^x\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[3^{x+1} = 3 \cdot 3^x\]
\[9^x = (3^2)^x = (3^x)^2\]
Kyun: \(a^{m+n} = a^m a^n\), aur \((a^m)^n = (a^n)^m\). Ab har term \(3^x\) mein hai.

\(y = 3^x\) rakhein (\(y > 0\))
\[3y - 2y^2 + 9 = 0\]
\[2y^2 - 3y - 9 = 0\]
\[(y - 3)(2y + 3) = 0\]
Kyun: \(-1\) se multiply kar ke leading term positive kiya; phir middle term ko \(-6y + 3y\) mein tora: \(2y(y - 3) + 3(y - 3)\).

Na-mumkin value rad karein
\(y = -\frac{3}{2}\): na-mumkin, kyunke \(3^x > 0\) har \(x\) ke liye.
\[3^x = 3 = 3^1 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
Kyun: exponential function one-to-one hai.
Dhyan dein: \(y\) ki negative value ko \(x\) mein badalne ki koshish na karein; koi real power negative number nahi deti.

Tasdeeq:
\[3^2 - 2 \cdot 9^1 + 9 = 9 - 18 + 9 = 0 \;\checkmark\]

blocks.explanation:
Yeh base \(\frac{1}{e}\) wali logarithmic equation hai, jis mein left side par \(x\) multiply ho raha hai.
Kitab mein right side par \(16^3\) chhapa hai, lekin is se answer key wala jawab nahi aata; asal sawal \(\log_{\frac{1}{e}}(16^x - 3)\) hai (neeche ghalti wala box dekhiye).
Rule kaunsa? Power law se \(x\) ko power bana denge, phir one-to-one property, phir \(y = 4^x\).
Plan: power law, arguments barabar, \(16^x = (4^x)^2\), quadratic, negative value rad, aur \(\log_4\) se \(x\).
steps:
Diya gaya (sahi shakal): \(x\log_{\frac{1}{e}} 4 = \log_{\frac{1}{e}}(16^x - 3)\).
Maloom karna: real solution \(x\).
Tareeqa: power law \(x\log_a 4 = \log_a 4^x\) se dono taraf ek hi base ke logarithm ban jate hain, to arguments barabar. Phir \(16^x = (4^x)^2\) hone ki wajah se \(y = 4^x\) rakhne par quadratic milti hai.

Domain
\[16^x - 3 > 0 \Rightarrow 16^x > 3\]
Kyun: logarithm ka argument positive hona chahiye. Base \(\frac{1}{e}\) positive hai aur 1 nahi, is liye jaiz (allowed) hai.

Left side par power law
\[\log_{\frac{1}{e}}(4^x) = \log_{\frac{1}{e}}(16^x - 3)\]
Kyun: \(k\log_a u = \log_a u^k\); yahan \(k = x\).

Arguments barabar rakhein
\[4^x = 16^x - 3\]
Kyun: kisi bhi jaiz base ka logarithm one-to-one hota hai. Base 1 se chhota ho tab bhi equation mein yeh rule wohi hai; base sirf inequality mein farq dalta hai.

\(y = 4^x\) rakhein (\(y > 0\))
\[16^x = (4^2)^x = (4^x)^2 = y^2\]
\[y = y^2 - 3\]
\[y^2 - y - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: \(16^x\) aur \(4^x\) ek hi base 4 se jure hue hain, is liye ek variable \(y\) mein aa gaye.

Quadratic hal karein
\[y = \dfrac{1 \pm \sqrt{1 + 12}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 \pm \sqrt{13}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(a = 1,\ b = -1,\ c = -3\); \(b^2 - 4ac = 1 + 12 = 13\).

Negative value rad karein
\(\frac{1 - \sqrt{13}}{2} \approx -1.30 < 0\): \(4^x\) ke liye na-mumkin.
\(\frac{1 + \sqrt{13}}{2} \approx 2.303\): qabool.
Kyun: \(4^x > 0\) har real \(x\) ke liye.

\(x\) nikalein
\[4^x = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{13}}{2}\]
\[x = \log_4\left(\dfrac{1 + \sqrt{13}}{2}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\log_2\left(\dfrac{1 + \sqrt{13}}{2}\right)\]
Kyun: change of base: \(\log_4 u = \frac{\log_2 u}{\log_2 4} = \frac{1}{2}\log_2 u\). Is shakal mein jawab answer key se milta hai. Taqreeban \(x \approx 0.6017\).

Tasdeeq:
\[16^x = y^2 = y + 3 \approx 5.303 > 3\]
Is liye \(x\) domain mein hai, aur \(16^x - 3 = y = 4^x\), yani dono taraf barabar \(\checkmark\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein right side \(\log_{\frac{1}{e}}(16^3 - 3)\) chhapi hai. \(16^3\) ke saath equation \(4^x = 16^3 - 3 = 4093\) ban jati hai, yani \(x = \log_4 4093 \approx 5.9995\), jo answer key se nahi milta. Answer key ka jawab \(\frac{1}{2}\log_2\left(\frac{1 + \sqrt{13}}{2}\right)\) sirf \(x\log_{\frac{1}{e}} 4 = \log_{\frac{1}{e}}(16^x - 3)\) ka hal hai, is liye power 3 asal mein \(x\) hai jo ghalti se 3 chhap gaya. Hum ne sahi equation hal ki hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh exponential equation hai jis mein \(2^x\) aur \(2^{-x}\) hain, aur \(2^{-x} = \frac{1}{2^x}\).
Diya kya hai? \(2^x + 2^{-x} = 5\). Find kya karna hai? Real solutions \(x\).
Rule kaunsa? Substitution \(y = 2^x\), phir fraction hatane ke liye \(y\) se multiply.
Plan: quadratic hal karna, dono values ka positive hona check karna, phir \(\log_2\) se \(x\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2^x + 2^{-x} = 5\).
Maloom karna: tamam real solutions \(x\).
Tareeqa: \(2^{-x} = \frac{1}{2^x}\), is liye \(y = 2^x\) rakhne se \(y + \frac{1}{y} = 5\) milta hai, jo \(y\) se multiply karne par quadratic ban jata hai.

Domain
\[\text{Domain} = ]-\infty, \infty[\]
Kyun: exponentials har real number ke liye maujood hain.

\(y = 2^x\) rakhein (\(y > 0\))
\[y + \dfrac{1}{y} = 5\]
\[y^2 + 1 = 5y\]
\[y^2 - 5y + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(y > 0\) se multiply karne se fraction khatam ho jata hai aur kuch nahi badalta (zero se multiply ka khatra nahi).

Quadratic formula
\[y = \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{25 - 4}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{21}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(a = 1,\ b = -5,\ c = 1\).

Dono values positive hain
\(\sqrt{21} \approx 4.58 < 5\), is liye \(\frac{5 \pm \sqrt{21}}{2}\) dono positive hain aur dono qabool.
\[x = \log_2\left(\dfrac{5 + \sqrt{21}}{2}\right) \approx 2.2604\]
\[x = \log_2\left(\dfrac{5 - \sqrt{21}}{2}\right) \approx -2.2604\]
Kyun: \(c > 0\) ke liye \(2^x = c \iff x = \log_2 c\).
Dhyan dein: pichle parts ki tarah yahan koi value rad nahi hoti; har dafa check karna hai, andaza nahi lagana.

Tasdeeq:
\[\dfrac{5 + \sqrt{21}}{2} \cdot \dfrac{5 - \sqrt{21}}{2} = \dfrac{25 - 21}{4} = 1\]
Yani dono roots ek doosre ka negative hain, aur aisa hi hona chahiye: \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhne se \(2^x + 2^{-x}\) nahi badalta. Saath hi \(4.791 + 0.209 = 5\) \(\checkmark\)
